architecture.runtime: static site (GitHub Pages), ES modules with an import map, no build step; Node ≥ 20 for tests, Python 3 for data builds

modules.js/model.js: vocabulary, decoding of data/hospitals.json, measures (beds | count), filters, pin sizes, short names
modules.js/profile-model.js: view models: overview, district, station, building, facility detail, affiliation card, comparison set (compsetOf)
modules.js/panel.js: reading-panel views as HTML strings: overview (+ affiliation card), district, station, building, facility (quality, lab prices, services, comparison set); one provenance line per view
modules.js/massing.js: city and focus massing tiers; CityMETER Building V4 inside CityMETER units (shapeCmTile, planCmRequests), OSM parts override, context layer, credit
modules.js/shell/camera.js: presets, pitched fits and the building camera (terrain-aware: groundAt, projectAltitude)
modules.js/labels.js: names near the middle of the view (importance = beds percentile + published accreditation), short names (รพ. · รพ.สต. · ศบส.), hover card of icon chips
modules.js/shell/terrain.js: terrain mode at hilly sites and round a building or facility being looked at (site relief), changes only while the camera is still
modules.js/shell/building-units.js: buildings per area: the per-province unit files (data/building-units/), CityMETER zones, production tile URLs and the attribution

rowScopes.scopeRows: rows after search · group · size · province · affiliation, before any district selection or focus: the comparison base of the Aha, the choropleth, the charts and every rank

rowScopes.rows: baseRows narrowed by the district focus: pins with detail, counters, the table (a building or station panel shows its own rows)
